mapper.select: SELECT incident_no, incident_id, capture_id, detected_at, created_at FROM incident_refs WHERE incident_id = ANY(#{incidentIds, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO incident_refs (incident_id, capture_id, detected_at, created_at) VALUES (#{incidentId}, #{captureId}, #{detectedAt}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
